scope: Authenticate delivery of completed original ACDSDATA sections to the adapter using an opt-in bounded codec-owned source ledger, independently of the overridable raw-section callback. Protect raw carrier transport only; no ACDS schema or ACIS/kernel interpretation.

preFixWitness.source: Existing locally authored generated opaque 3DSOLID/ACDS fixture in ignored build scratch
preFixWitness.mutatedCopy: Overriding addRawDxfSection to forward a copy with first 310=41434454 instead of 41434453 produced import=1, unchanged=1, export=1; the 3DSOLID and altered section were output.
preFixWitness.droppedCallback: Overriding the callback to do nothing produced import=1, sections=0, unchanged=1, export=1; output retained the 3DSOLID and omitted ACDSDATA.
preFixWitness.limitations: This is a synthetic opaque source: altered or missing bytes do not establish native ACIS semantics or a genuine kernel failure.

implementation: Before invoking the raw-section callback, opted-in codec captures a bounded exact source section and exposes its borrowed active address only during callback. The adapter checks source publication address and reconciles the completed codec ledger against the captured ordered per-generation baselines at read completion. Missing, copied, changed, duplicate or exceptional delivery and budget failure set sticky ACDS capture failure; authored/no-import and ordinary no-ACDS 2D paths remain supported. Existing output transaction and later source immutability checks remain in force.
budget: Ledger limits records, groups, retained bytes and work; source sizing traversal is precharged before visiting payload. Work includes copy and comparison; an unavailable ledger cannot qualify delivery.

postFixReproduction.result: Both attempted changed and omitted deliveries import but mark source unchanged=false and refuse export. The focused suite separately checks destination sentinel and fresh same-adapter retries.

controls: 8 normal outputs and 48 failures/retries across ASCII/binary source and output plus strict/compatible modes; copied identical, modified bytes, dropped, duplicate, wrong version and renamed section. Includes exact/one-below quotas, large section/tiny work, quota failure after accepted prefix, multi-section late drop/duplicate/exception, sticky same-data reimport, fresh retry, opt-out/read reset, plain 2D and authored/no-import behavior. Completed records only.

chronology: The recorded source files were frozen throughout the normal and ASan builds; subsequent uncommitted MLINE work is outside those test bindings.
limitations: Only completed sections that the codec parsed are observed; detection of uncompleted/unreached source sections is not established.
This is physical source/delivery authentication, not original DWG-to-AcDs owner/schema join, native payload validity, geometry, complete document conversion or an independent kernel qualification.
New opt-in public methods and dxfRW private layout change require consumer rebuild and formal ABI/API qualification. DRW_Interface gained no pure virtuals.
